allocation_definition: a=#(A0,B0) among only-A0 records; b=#(A1,B0) among only-A1; c=#(A0,B0) among only-B0; d=#(A0,B1) among only-B1. Lexicographic a,b,c,d ascending.
bounds: unknown both-high event only where neither observed binary is0. Lower observed11/1600; upper possible-high-count/1600. Sharp binary-event support, not full-score support or CI.
conditional_chain: for each posterior theta draw derive A|B and B|A. Build exact 4x4 full-sweep row-stochastic matrices for AB and BA. Enumerate powers at1,2,5,10,25,50 sweeps from all four starts; compare total variation to theta; no random chain used as an exact posterior reference.
display: 17 significant digits CSV, integer binary fields exact; no nonfinite or invented undefined number
draw_order: per completion group ascending: allocation uniform then four Gammaquantile uniforms; then partial records by group and row0,row1,col0,col1, each sortedID, sequential uniform subset with fixed allocated success count; then bothmissing sortedID single joint categorical uniform.
example_selection: first sortedID with exactly one of st1/st2 missing and the other raw answer4or5, chosen before fit; fullscore and ordinal missing values are not reconstructed
exclusions: replacement full five-item joint MI model
ordinal raw answers inferred from binary categories
failures: raw support not blank or exact1..5
finite_moments: H=observed11+(mrow1-b)+(mcol1-d), M=bothmissing. Given allocation, K for bothmissing is beta-binomial(M,alpha11,A-alpha11). E(total)=H+M*mu, Var(total)=M*mu*(1-mu)*(A+M)/(A+1). Total variance adds mixture variance of conditional means. Independent group totals sum, divide by1600 or1600squared.
fixed_parameter_scope: derived full conditionals at fixed theta; not a generic theorem equating independently refitted FCS with joint-model posterior sampling
gamma: unit-scale Gamma(alpha integer>=1) inverseCDF; independent scalar series/continued fraction, NumPy quadrature, Rqgamma; absolute or relative1e-11 comparison, no new dependency
joint_model: independent people conditional on group-specific p00,p01,p10,p11; independent Dirichlet(1,1,1,1) priors across groups. Both missing contribute likelihood1; partial records contribute observed marginal cell probabilities.
mixing_warning: maxTV at50 across all80 posterior group draws and bothscanorders; warning retained even if arithmetic passes, never extend grid after results
observation_model: joint response and two-item pattern ignorability conditional on fully observed group; parameters distinct from group-specific joint probabilities. Strong unverified working assumption; World latent-dependent response knowledge acknowledged.
posterior: enumerate binomial expansions of four observed marginal factors. For each allocation multiply its combinatorial coefficient by B(alpha_alloc)/B(prior+complete_counts); log-sum-exp normalize. Alpha includes every observed partial record through allocation, not both-missing records.
posterior_bound: Chebyshev conditional at-least95% using exact finite posterior mean/variance, intersect binary-event support. Conservative posterior content under working model, not central credible interval or demonstrated frequentist coverage.
target: finite1600-person proportion whose two raw baseline stress answers st1 and st2 would both be4or5 at the declared baseline reference administration
target_role: explicitly coarsened diagnostic, not B8-T01 five-item stress mean or causal effect; no original target edited
toy: explicit positive binary conditional probabilities in unit06_conditionals.csv; compute conditional odds-ratio agreement, transition matrices, each order stationary law via independent linear solvers and invariant residuals. An incompatible positive kernel can converge; convergence alone does not imply compatibility.
